required.name: Shutdown/industrial project experience assisting qualified trades
Current Working at Heights, Confined Space & Gas Test Atmospheres (within 2 years)
required.hint: working at heights/WAH; confined space entry; gas test atmospheres/GTA; valid/current; issued ≤ 2 years

required.name: Able to perform physically demanding labour safely
required.hint: manual handling; use of hand tools; assisting with heavy lifts; fit for site work

required.name: Strong safety awareness and willingness to follow instructions/site procedures
required.hint: JSA/JSEA/Take 5; follows procedures; listens to direction

required.name: Current driver’s licence
required.hint: driver licence/driver's license/QLD open or P

positives.name: Experience in coal terminals, CHPPs, or large mining shutdowns
Exposure to stacker-reclaimers, draglines, conveyors, or port infrastructure
Basic mechanical/electrical aptitude
positives.hint: use of power tools, drills, grinders; basic trade aptitude

positives.name: Interest in progressing towards trade qualification
positives.hint: keen to start apprenticeship, learn trade

positives.name: Reliability and work ethic in shutdown/project roles
Willingness to support multiple trades flexibly
positives.hint: helping fitters, riggers, boilermakers as needed

positives.name: Good teamwork and communication
positives.hint: works well in teams, communicates with supervisors

positives.name: Consistent work history with reputable mining contractors
positives.hint: Monadelphous, Kaefer, Richglen, CQ Field, FMS Group, etc.

red_flags.name: No prior site-based or shutdown experience
red_flags.hint: never worked on-site, no shutdown/project history

red_flags.name: Missing mandatory safety certifications
red_flags.hint: no White Card, Heights, Confined Space, Gas Test

red_flags.name: Reluctance to perform manual/physical tasks
red_flags.hint: not willing or unable to perform labour-intensive work

red_flags.name: Unexplained employment gaps or poor reliability
red_flags.hint: job hopping, short stints, gaps without explanation

red_flags.name: Indicators of poor safety behaviour or refusal to follow direction
red_flags.hint: ignores safety, fails to follow instructions
